```{r setup}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(showtext)
library(grid)

project_dir <- normalizePath("/home/xuyanbo/project/MOF_TAPS", mustWork = TRUE)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(dpi = 300, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 3.2)

font_file <- "/home/xuyanbo/ARIAL.TTF"
font_family <- "sans"

if (file.exists(font_file)) {
  font_add(family = "Arial", regular = font_file)
  showtext_auto()
  showtext_opts(dpi = 300)
  font_family <- "Arial"
}

method_order <- c("TAPS", "TAPS+", "MOF-TAPS")
input_order <- c("1 ng", "100 pg", "10 pg")

method_colors <- c(
  "TAPS"     = "#63B34C",
  "TAPS+"    = "#E59A2F",
  "MOF-TAPS" = "#3B82C4"
)

out_fig_dir <- file.path(
  project_dir,
  "analysis", "fig_factory", "fig", "FigSI",
  "hela_gDNA_correlation"
)
out_table_dir <- file.path(
  project_dir,
  "analysis", "fig_factory", "tables", "FigSI",
  "hela_gDNA_correlation"
)
dir.create(out_fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(out_table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

min_cov <- 3L
corr_chromosome_mode <- "autosomes"
corr_bin_size <- 10000L
min_corr_bin_total_N <- 10L
min_corr_bin_cpgs <- 1L
corr_density_bins <- 50L
```

```{r sample-meta}
  method = c(
    "TAPS", "TAPS", "TAPS",

  input_amount = c(
```

```{r paired-input-map}
sample_pair_files <- sample_info %>%
  select(input_amount, method, sample, file)

method_pairs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~pair_id, ~x_method, ~y_method,
  "TAPS_vs_TAPS_plus", "TAPS", "TAPS+",
  "TAPS_vs_MOF_TAPS", "TAPS", "MOF-TAPS",
  "TAPS_plus_vs_MOF_TAPS", "TAPS+", "MOF-TAPS"
)

pair_info <- tidyr::crossing(
  input_amount = factor(input_order, levels = input_order),
  method_pairs
) %>%
  mutate(input_index = as.integer(input_amount)) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_pair_files %>% rename(x_method = method, x_sample = sample, x_file = file),
    by = c("input_amount", "x_method")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_info %>%
      select(input_amount, method, sample, file) %>%
      rename(y_method = method, y_sample = sample, y_file = file),
    by = c("input_amount", "y_method")
  ) %>%
  mutate(pair_label = paste(x_method, "vs", y_method)) %>%
  arrange(match(pair_id, method_pairs$pair_id), input_index)

if (any(is.na(pair_info$x_file)) || any(is.na(pair_info$y_file))) {
  print(pair_info)
  stop("Cannot resolve all pairwise method input pairs.", call. = FALSE)
}

data.table::fwrite(
  pair_info,
  file.path(out_table_dir, "paired_input_map.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

pair_info
```

# Summarize methylation by genomic bins

```{r helper-summarize-mergecontext-bins}
summarize_md_bins <- function(file, bin_size, chromosome_mode) {
  if (!file.exists(file)) stop("File does not exist: ", file, call. = FALSE)

  cmd <- paste0(
    "zcat -f ", shQuote(file),
    " | awk -v BS=", bin_size,
    " -v MINCOV=", min_cov,
    " -v CHR=", shQuote(chromosome_mode),
    " '",
    "BEGIN{OFS=\"\\t\"} ",
    "$0 !~ /^(track|browser|#)/ { ",
    "  if (CHR == \"primary\") { keep = ($1 ~ /^chr([1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-2]|X|Y)$/) } ",
    "  else if (CHR == \"autosomes\") { keep = ($1 ~ /^chr([1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-2])$/) } ",
    "  else { keep = ($1 == CHR) } ",
    "  if (!keep) next; ",
    "  cov = $5 + $6; ",
    "  if (cov >= MINCOV) { ",
    "    bin = int($2 / BS) * BS; ",
    "    m = $6; u = $5; ",
    "    key = $1 SUBSEP bin; ",
    "    msum[key] += m; usum[key] += u; nsum[key] += cov; cpg[key] += 1; ",
    "  } ",
    "} ",
    "END{ ",
    "  for (key in nsum) { ",
    "    split(key, a, SUBSEP); ",
    "    print a[1], a[2], a[2] + BS, a[2] + BS / 2, msum[key], usum[key], nsum[key], cpg[key]; ",
    "  } ",
    "}'"
  )

  x <- fread(
    cmd = cmd,
    header = FALSE,
    col.names = c("chr", "bin_start", "bin_end", "bin_mid", "m", "u", "N", "covered_CpGs"),
    showProgress = FALSE
  )

  if (nrow(x) == 0L) {
    return(data.table(
      chr = character(), bin_start = integer(), bin_end = integer(), bin_mid = numeric(),
      m = numeric(), u = numeric(), N = numeric(), covered_CpGs = integer(),
      modification_rate = numeric()
    ))
  }

  x[, `:=`(
    bin_start = as.integer(bin_start),
    bin_end = as.integer(bin_end),
    bin_mid = as.numeric(bin_mid),
    m = as.numeric(m),
    u = as.numeric(u),
    N = as.numeric(N),
    covered_CpGs = as.integer(covered_CpGs)
  )]

  x <- x[N > 0]
  x[, modification_rate := 100 * m / N]
  setorder(x, chr, bin_start)
  x[]
}
```

```{r summarize-all-samples-correlation-bins}
corr_sample_bin_list <- vector("list", nrow(sample_info))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(sample_info))) {
  message("Summarizing ", corr_chromosome_mode, " ", corr_bin_size, " bp bins for ", sample_info$sample[i])

  x <- summarize_md_bins(
    file = sample_info$file[i],
    bin_size = corr_bin_size,
    chromosome_mode = corr_chromosome_mode
  )

  x <- x[N >= min_corr_bin_total_N & covered_CpGs >= min_corr_bin_cpgs]

  x[, sample := sample_info$sample[i]]
  x[, input_amount := as.character(sample_info$input_amount[i])]
  x[, method := as.character(sample_info$method[i])]

  corr_sample_bin_list[[i]] <- x
}

corr_sample_bin_df <- rbindlist(corr_sample_bin_list, use.names = TRUE)
corr_sample_bin_df[, input_amount := factor(input_amount, levels = input_order)]
corr_sample_bin_df[, method := factor(method, levels = method_order)]

corr_sample_summary <- corr_sample_bin_df[
  ,
  .(
    n_bins = .N,
    total_N = sum(N),
    total_CpGs = sum(covered_CpGs),
    mean_bin_modification_rate = mean(modification_rate)
  ),
  by = .(sample, input_amount, method)
]

data.table::fwrite(
  corr_sample_summary,
  file.path(out_table_dir, paste0("sample_level_", corr_chromosome_mode, "_", corr_bin_size, "bp_bin_summary.tsv")),
  sep = "\t"
)

corr_sample_summary
```

# Paired input method correlations

```{r summarize-paired-correlation-bins}
pair_plot_list <- vector("list", nrow(pair_info))
pair_label_list <- vector("list", nrow(pair_info))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(pair_info))) {
  p <- pair_info[i, ]

  x_dt <- corr_sample_bin_df[
    sample == p$x_sample,
    .(chr, bin_start, bin_end, bin_mid, x_rate = modification_rate, x_N = N, x_CpGs = covered_CpGs)
  ]

  y_dt <- corr_sample_bin_df[
    sample == p$y_sample,
    .(chr, bin_start, bin_end, bin_mid, y_rate = modification_rate, y_N = N, y_CpGs = covered_CpGs)
  ]

  shared_dt <- merge(
    x_dt,
    y_dt,
    by = c("chr", "bin_start", "bin_end", "bin_mid"),
    all = FALSE
  )

  input_label <- as.character(p$input_amount)
  pair_label <- as.character(p$pair_label)

  pair_plot_list[[i]] <- shared_dt[
    ,
    `:=`(
      input_amount = as.character(p$input_amount),
      input_index = p$input_index,
      input_label = input_label,
      pair_id = p$pair_id,
      pair_label = pair_label,
      x_method = p$x_method,
      y_method = p$y_method
    )
  ]

  pair_label_list[[i]] <- data.table(
    input_amount = as.character(p$input_amount),
    input_index = p$input_index,
    input_label = input_label,
    pair_id = p$pair_id,
    pair_label = pair_label,
    x_method = p$x_method,
    y_method = p$y_method,
    n_bins = nrow(shared_dt),
    pearson_r = if (nrow(shared_dt) >= 3) cor(shared_dt$x_rate, shared_dt$y_rate, method = "pearson") else NA_real_,
    spearman_rho = if (nrow(shared_dt) >= 3) cor(shared_dt$x_rate, shared_dt$y_rate, method = "spearman") else NA_real_,
    mean_abs_delta = if (nrow(shared_dt) > 0) mean(abs(shared_dt$y_rate - shared_dt$x_rate)) else NA_real_
  )
}

pair_corr_plot_df <- rbindlist(pair_plot_list, use.names = TRUE)
pair_corr_label <- rbindlist(pair_label_list, use.names = TRUE)

input_levels <- input_order
pair_levels <- method_pairs$pair_id
pair_label_levels <- pair_info %>%
  distinct(pair_id, pair_label) %>%
  arrange(match(pair_id, pair_levels)) %>%
  pull(pair_label)

pair_corr_plot_df[, input_label := factor(input_label, levels = input_levels)]
pair_corr_label[, input_label := factor(input_label, levels = input_levels)]
pair_corr_plot_df[, pair_id := factor(pair_id, levels = pair_levels)]
pair_corr_label[, pair_id := factor(pair_id, levels = pair_levels)]
pair_corr_plot_df[, pair_label := factor(pair_label, levels = pair_label_levels)]
pair_corr_label[, pair_label := factor(pair_label, levels = pair_label_levels)]
pair_corr_label[, label := paste0("r = ", sprintf("%.2f", pearson_r))]
pair_corr_label[, `:=`(x = 5, y = 96)]

data.table::fwrite(
  pair_corr_label,
  file.path(out_table_dir, paste0("paired_", corr_chromosome_mode, "_", corr_bin_size, "bp_method_correlation_summary.tsv")),
  sep = "\t"
)

data.table::fwrite(
  pair_corr_plot_df,
  file.path(out_table_dir, paste0("paired_", corr_chromosome_mode, "_", corr_bin_size, "bp_method_correlation_plot_data.tsv")),
  sep = "\t"
)
```

```{r bin-count-scale}
tmp_bin_plot <- ggplot(
  pair_corr_plot_df,
  aes(x = x_rate, y = y_rate)
) +
  geom_bin_2d(bins = corr_density_bins) +
  facet_grid(pair_label ~ input_label)

tmp_bin_data_all <- ggplot_build(tmp_bin_plot)$data[[1]]

bin_count_min <- 1L
display_quantile <- 0.95
bin_count_max_display <- ceiling(
  as.numeric(quantile(tmp_bin_data_all$count, display_quantile, na.rm = TRUE)) / 1000
) * 1000
bin_count_max_display <- max(bin_count_max_display, 10L)

bin_count_breaks <- c(bin_count_min, bin_count_max_display)
bin_count_labels <- c("1", scales::comma(bin_count_max_display))

bin_count_labels
```

```{r plot-paired-bin-correlation}
p_paired_bin_correlation <- ggplot(
  pair_corr_plot_df,
  aes(x = x_rate, y = y_rate)
) +
  geom_bin_2d(aes(fill = after_stat(count)), bins = corr_density_bins, alpha = 1) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#F7FBFF",
    high = method_colors["MOF-TAPS"],
    limits = c(bin_count_min, bin_count_max_display),
    oob = scales::squish,
    breaks = bin_count_breaks,
    labels = bin_count_labels,
    name = "Bin count",
    guide = guide_colourbar(
      barheight = unit(2.0, "cm"),
      barwidth = unit(0.35, "cm"),
      ticks = TRUE,
      frame.colour = "black"
    )
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.42,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = pair_corr_label,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 4.2,
    family = font_family,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  facet_grid(pair_label ~ input_label) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
    labels = percent_label,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
    labels = percent_label,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  coord_fixed(
    xlim = c(0, 100),
    ylim = c(0, 100),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "First method methylation level",
    y = "Second method methylation level"
  ) +
  theme_figsi +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.32, linetype = "dashed"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1.6, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_paired_bin_correlation
```
